rows.grounds: describes the condition of the garment; first member of compound with vastrā
final member of bahuvrīhi compound qualifying sā; indicates possession of worn clothing
demonstrative pronoun referring to the goddess described in preceding verses

items.question: What worn attire characterizes the goddess in this continuing description?
premises: The subject is identified as she, the goddess.
Her clothing is described as worn.
The description continues the prior depiction of decrepitude.
items.inference: The goddess is characterized as clad in worn garments.
uncertainties: Whether vastrā is read as a simple bahuvrīhi final or carries additional nuance is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Page 270. She is clad in worn garments.
